book.name: Salmos
book.title: Israelchich Apanlleem yaseerangana anu Israelchich Apanlleem yaseerangana anu

content: Yuwamand Apanll kanindaa tinarangu anumand, Apanll kizpurcha atiniya. Yuwamand Apanll waanaatsee kuku tputseem tuyandarangu anumand, Apanll iyaa kizpur chinakiya, atini, anoo kamankiya

content.text: Kanind iyaam Apanllee wizpur tuyamandakiya.
Zari, tsuptam, tsangachtam iyaa; tsiyatakpaz ashku; Apanllimarita kizpurcha, atanaya.
Apanll zaree kanindush wayarangu, uru putam taraseeta, putam taraseeta ashimaam kamachtarangiya.
Tapeekchu anush, tsupeetstam, tsangacheetstam wayarangiya.
Tsup nduntaati tsiyatku, zartam nduntaati tsiyatku,
tputssha nduntaa kukoo mazinaksin, ashtaa,
Yuwamand Apanll kanindaa tinarangu,
anumand tputs ztaru Apanllee yasakanaya.
Waamari kasiriya, atanaya.
Apanll zaree kanindush wayarangu, zarsha putam shitungata, putam shitungata ashku, itsinsaru naakiya.
Kanungas kizaa yamapi átu, kizapiri itsinsaru naataru, zarsha ambtampaz ashiru shitungachu, itsinsaru naakiya.
Mishat, zar, tputs mang' kis iriptaru ashiritam nda nizimaam yasariya.
Zari puturita shitungeeru, itsinsaru naaku,
yap pshtuku amb izuuru pshtukiya.
Ichingaroom tputs zarish ksaneekanaya.
Apanll taarashee kaneesich tputseem panapi átu, waanaatsee kuk iyaam panarangiya.
Apanlli kuk kizpurcha wanasiri. Apanll nda minamtiyam yutarit tsiyatarangiya.
Ichinguru tputs Apanllee kuk mangoonamaam taariya.
Tputs mang' nduntaa, itaru Apanllee kuk mangoonku, yasampaz ashiru wanasiri chinakiya.
Apanll kuk iyaam itsinsaru taamaam kamankiya.
Tputssha payukinaariya, kissha taachiya.
Apanll kuk nda minamtiyam yutam kamankiya.
Tputsush mang' tuwasineekiya wanasiri chinamaama.
Tputs Apanllee puniku, uru itsinsaru tachitkiya.
Apanll; Tputs wanasiri kis taapana, átu, anooma kamachtamarineetsi panarangiya.
Nda iyaa kiyung yachamaam zandkiya.
Apaa, shiy kukish kizpur wanasircha.
Shiyaa kukish payumaam orootstaa arangeem kasiru wanasiri.
Kinduraa wakunguri waakuri kizpur kisa.
Itaru, shiyaatssha kukish payukuri, aranginasha mangi ksakina.
Apaa, nuwaa shiycha tputsirish.
Shiy kukish nuwaa mangi p'tseeku, shiyaatsimari tuminpi, atina.
Tputs shiyaa kukish payuksin, shiysha aranginasha istaksha.
Itaru Apaa, ¿chakaja waanaatsee yutaritshishirini ichingaru yásach?
Ichingaru yasamaam pinasakaniya
Ashiri Apaa, shiysha nuwaa yutaritshishireetsi ichingaru tchingangandama.
Istangandama Apaa, nda nuwaanaatstamari chinamaama. Watam an yutaritawa.
Shiy nuwaa istakush, nuwsha yutaritshishireetsi kasichima.
Ashkachuri, yuwaa wanasir chinaki, mishat wanasir tsiyatki, anoo shiysha kis mazinachsha.
Shiy nuwaa tapachindaksha; mishat ksutaksha.
Ashiri Apaa, wappari, atina.

footnotes.text: Yuwaa nish átu anootstam Romshucheema 10.8 tayusima kamankiya.
